parsed.production_notes: The video uses a split-screen format combining an AI-generated avatar on top and stock ASMR footage on the bottom. The top character has a human face but a robotic head/neck, with slightly unnatural lip-sync and perfectly static framing typical of AI video generators.

characters.appearance: Male humanoid robot. He has a realistic human face with fair complexion and short brown hair on top, but the sides, back of the head, and neck are exposed metallic robotic components with wires. He has a clean-shaven face and a serious expression.
characters.wardrobe: Dark blue button-down collared shirt. He holds a black handheld microphone.
characters.demeanor: Informative, serious, and slightly stiff, delivering a direct address to the camera.

scenes.setting: Top: Stage with blurred lights. Bottom: Tabletop with a brick wall background.

panels.panel_visual_description: Character A, a male humanoid robot with a human face and exposed metallic skull and neck, is framed from the chest up. He wears a dark blue collared shirt and holds a black microphone near his mouth, speaking directly to the camera. The background is dark with several out-of-focus, warm circular lights.

A close-up shot of a hand pushing a black wire mesh basket downwards onto a cylindrical pile of beige kinetic sand. As the basket is pressed down, the sand squeezes and extrudes through the small hexagonal holes of the mesh. The background features a blurred grey brick wall.

scenes.visual_description: The screen is split horizontally. The top half features an AI-generated humanoid robot speaking into a microphone against a stage-like background. The bottom half displays a satisfying ASMR clip of a hand pressing a wire mesh into kinetic sand. Large text overlays appear in the center of the screen.
